protocol.indexing: first divergence is zero-based, including first missing token for strict prefixes; quartiles conditional on divergence
protocol.process_pairs: all unordered pairs, including every cross-arm process-index pairing; same warm-repeat index paired (three repeats)
protocol.within_process: all three pairs of warm repeats, each process separately
protocol.matching_subset: identical completion IDs across full and distilled, all six processes and all three warm repeats; no selection on timing
protocol.batch8: retain only original batches whose every query matches; never apportion shared batch wall time
protocol.first_divergence_truncated_timing: not identifiable: only total batch elapsed time was recorded, without per-token timestamps; token-count prorating would not measure prefix throughput
protocol.inference: matching-output subset is a conditional sensitivity analysis; its representativeness can differ from the complete evaluation panel
protocol.bootstrap: 10000 paired process and original prompt-batch resamples; warm repetitions averaged within process
